subject: Fluxion Labs — Dedicated demo & throughput constraints
messages:
From: Emily Kline <emily@fluxion.ai>
To: sales@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for Fluxion — QPS and latency needs

Hi —

We signed up via the self-serve flow this morning and selected Dedicated capacity for an upcoming pilot. Quick context: we run a customer-facing inference pipeline (semantic search + chat) and expect a steady-state of ~600 QPS during peak hours with 99th-pct latency requirements around 120–150ms for short chat prompts. We also have a small burst profile up to ~1.2k QPS for scheduled events.

I've attached a quick spreadsheet with payload size, sequence length distribution, and a sample traffic curve (fluxion_throughput_spec.xlsx). Can we schedule a 30–45 minute walkthrough focused on throughput/latency sizing and fallback strategies? Prefer next week in US-PST mornings.

Thanks,
Emily Kline
Head of Platform Engineering
Fluxion Labs

Attachment: fluxion_throughput_spec.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Kline <emily@fluxion.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for Fluxion — QPS and latency needs

Hi Emily —

Thanks for the details and the spreadsheet. Appreciate the clarity on steady-state and burst profiles. I looped in Karthik (solutions engineering) and Monica (SDR) so we can get an ops-forward walkthrough and lock a calendar slot.

Proposed 30–45m options (PST mornings):
- Wed 2025-07-16 09:00–09:45
- Thu 2025-07-17 10:00–10:45
- Fri 2025-07-18 08:30–09:15

Agenda proposal:
1) Quick intro + pilot goals (5m)
2) Traffic pattern & latency SLOs (10m)
3) Dedicated capacity sizing and multi-region strategy (15m)
4) Fallbacks, KV/prefix caching, and cost levers (10m)
5) Next steps / actions (5m)

If those don't work, what windows next week are best for you? Also curious whether you want a pre-call to review the spreadsheet with Karthik beforehand — he can do a 20m deep-dive if you'd like.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Emily Kline <emily@fluxion.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Malhotra <raj@fluxion.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for Fluxion — QPS and latency needs

Ben —

Thanks for the quick reply. Thu 2025-07-17 10:00–10:45 PST works for us. Raj and I will join. A couple of clarifications ahead of the call:
- Our 99th-pct latency budget is 150ms for 16–64 token responses; for longer sequences (250–1k tokens) we need predictable tail latencies, ideally <400ms on dedicated GPUs.
- We need multi-region read replicas in EU + US by the time of pilot (data residency + user location).
- We are particularly interested in how Redwood handles prefix caching for repeated contexts and autoscale behavior during spikes.

No pre-call required unless Karthik wants to run through the spreadsheet — otherwise we can cover on Thu.

Best,
Emily
